reason: Build the six-band LUT only after published-source provenance and source-structure QA pass. R5.7.41.3.4.10.11.1 corrects hollow_column source resolution and accepts source-row wavelength-dependent geometry using a Dmax-first authoritative key.

preferred_source.name: Yang/Bi ice particle single-scattering database Version 2
references: Yang et al. 2013, Journal of the Atmospheric Sciences 70, 330-347, DOI 10.1175/JAS-D-12-039.1
Bi & Yang 2017, Journal of Quantitative Spectroscopy and Radiative Transfer 189, 228-237

source_wavelength_policy: Exact source wavelength when available; otherwise linear interpolation strictly inside the published source spectral grid; no extrapolation.
size_coordinate_note: Authoritative key = habit + roughness + Dmax + wavelength. D_eff=1.5*V/A and r_eff=D_eff/2 are retained per source row as diagnostic/mapping metadata only; no unvalidated r_eff->Dmax substitution is permitted.
release_gate: Portable calibrated LUT release requires published archive MD5 verification plus complete 27-file source QA, six-band spectral-domain QA, finite optics, positive source-row geometry, Dmax-key uniqueness, and complete six-band Dmax groups. Cross-wavelength V/A invariance is diagnostic only, not a hard gate.
frozen_rule: Missing != Clear != Zero; no RH/CF proxy or unlabelled fixed r_eff/habit may synthesize spectral ice tau.
